name: Takasato Laila
source:
The homeroom teacher of the protagonist's class. She often acts flirtatiously and suggestively toward the students (especially the protagonist).

Many students seem captivated by Laila, thinking about her night after night. The protagonist is also constantly troubled by Laila's overly seductive attitude.

To Laila, the protagonist is apparently “a cute student who always listens to what I say.”

[From [url=http://www.ole-m.net/products/ironmaiden/chara.html]official site[/url]]
